arXiv:2605.14723v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 5 月 14 日arXiv:2605.14723v1 [cs.AI] 14 May 2026

代理化Agentifying患者动态Patient Dynamics法学硕士内within LLMs
通过与临床世界模型互动through Interacting with Clinical World Model

Minghao Wu1†, Yuting Yan1†, Zhenyang Cai1†, Ke Ji1, Chuangsen Fang2,
Ziying Sheng1, Xidong Wang1, Rongsheng Wang1, Hejia Zhang1,
Shuang Li1, Benyou Wang1∗, Hongyuan Zha1∗
1 The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen 2 Beijing Hospital
{wangbenyou, zhahy}@cuhk.edu.cn
https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/SepsisAgent
摘要Abstract

ICU 中的脓毒症管理需要根据快速变化的患者生理状况做出连续的治疗决策。尽管大语言模型 (LLM) 编码了广泛的临床知识，并且可以根据指南进行推理，但它们本质上并不基于以行动为条件的患者动态。我们介绍Sepsis management in the ICU requires sequential treatment decisions under rapidly evolving patient physiology. Although large language models (LLMs) encode broad clinical knowledge and can reason over guidelines, they are not inherently grounded in action-conditioned patient dynamics. We introduce败血症代理SepsisAgent，一种用于脓毒症治疗推荐的世界模型增强法学硕士药剂。 SepsisAgent 使用学习的临床世界模型来模拟患者在候选液体-血管加压药干预下的反应，并在提交处方之前遵循建议-模拟-细化工作流程。我们首先表明，仅访问世界模型会产生不一致的 LLM 决策性能，从而激励特定于代理的培训。然后，我们通过三个阶段的课程来训练 SepsisAgent：患者动态监督微调、提议-模拟-细化行为克隆以及基于世界模型的代理强化学习。在 MIMIC-IV 败血症轨迹上，SepsiAgent 在非政策价值方面优于所有传统的基于 RL 和 LLM 的基线，同时在指南遵守和不安全行动指标下实现了最佳安全性。进一步的分析表明，与临床世界模型的重复交互使代理能够了解患者进化的规律，即使在模拟器访问被移除的情况下，这些规律仍然有用。, a world model-augmented LLM agent for sepsis treatment recommendation. SepsisAgent uses a learned Clinical World Model to simulate patient responses under candidate fluid–vasopressor interventions, and follows a propose–simulate–refine workflow before committing to a prescription. We first show that world-model access alone yields inconsistent LLM decision performance, motivating agent-specific training. We then train SepsisAgent through a three-stage curriculum: patient-dynamics supervised fine-tuning, propose–simulate–refine behavior cloning, and world-model-based agentic reinforcement learning. On MIMIC-IV sepsis trajectories, SepsisAgent outperforms all traditional RL and LLM-based baselines in off-policy value while achieving the best safety profile under guideline adherence and unsafe-action metrics. Further analysis shows that repeated interaction with the Clinical World Model enables the agent to learn regularities in patient evolution, which remain useful even when simulator access is removed.

1 简介Introduction

脓毒症仍然是重症监护病房 (ICU) 死亡的主要原因，对重症监护医学提出了重大挑战Sepsis remains a leading cause of mortality in Intensive Care Units (ICUs), presenting a major challenge in critical care medicineSinger et al. (2016); Rudd et al. (2020); Rhee et al. (2017)。有效的管理需要临床医生随着时间的推移滴定静脉输液和升压药以恢复灌注，同时避免下游器官损伤。这使得脓毒症治疗成为一个高风险的问题. Effective management requires clinicians to titrate intravenous fluids and vasopressors over time to restore perfusion while avoiding downstream organ injury. This makes sepsis treatment a high-stakes顺序决策sequential decision-making问题：改善短期血流动力学的措施仍可能使长期结果恶化，例如当积极的液体复苏恢复血压但增加肺水肿或肾衰竭的风险时problem: actions that improve short-term hemodynamics may still worsen long-term outcomes, for example when aggressive fluid resuscitation restores blood pressure but increases the risk of pulmonary edema or renal failureDobson et al. (2024); Meyhoff et al. (2022); Douglas et al. (2020)。临床医生必须在大量认知负荷下做出这些决定，整合高维生理流. Clinicians must make these decisions under substantial cognitive load, integrating high-dimensional physiological streamsHelman et al. (2022)同时考虑患者特定的异质性while accounting for patient-specific heterogeneityKomorowski et al. (2018); Seymour et al. (2019)。这激发了将临床知识与患者动态相结合的决策支持系统. This motivates decision-support systems that combine clinical knowledge with patient dynamicsBoussina et al. (2024).

大语言模型 (LLM) 为临床决策支持提供了一个有前途的界面，因为它们可以解释异质的临床背景、对医疗指南进行推理并提供自然语言的基本原理Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising interface for clinical decision support because they can interpret heterogeneous clinical context, reason over medical guidelines, and provide natural-language rationalesXu et al. (2025b); Sellergren et al. (2025); Chen et al. (2024a)。然而，法学硕士本质上并不以患者动态为基础。他们可能知道升压药通常会增加血压，但仍然无法估计特定患者在接下来的几个小时内对特定剂量的反应. However, LLMs are not inherently grounded in patient dynamics. They may know that vasopressors increase blood pressure in general, but still fail to estimate how a specific patient will respond to a specific dose over the next few hoursWornow et al. (2023)。这种限制在脓毒症中尤其成问题，治疗决策的质量不仅取决于它是否符合指南，还取决于它如何改变患者未来的轨迹。. This limitation is especially problematic in sepsis, where the quality of a treatment decision depends not only on whether it is guideline-consistent, but also on how it changes the patient’s future trajectory.

解决这一限制的一个自然方法是通过患者动态的预测模型来增强法学硕士。我们定义一个A natural way to address this limitation is to augment the LLM with a predictive model of patient dynamics. We define a临床世界模型Clinical World Model作为患者进化的一种习得的、以行动为条件的近似。给定患者状态和候选治疗行动，世界模型可以预测可能的生理反应和下游结果信号。这为法学硕士提供了一种在开出处方之前比较反事实治疗方案的机制。然而，仅访问世界模型是不够的：预测的轨迹是近似的，通用法学硕士可能会过度信任短期模拟改进或误解嘈杂的反馈。因此，关键的挑战不仅是构建模拟器，还在于训练能够正确使用模拟患者反应的代理。as a learned, action-conditioned approximation of patient evolution. Given a patient state and a candidate treatment action, the world model predicts possible physiological responses and downstream outcome signals. This gives the LLM a mechanism to compare counterfactual treatment options before committing to a prescription. Yet world-model access alone is insufficient: predicted trajectories are approximate, and a generic LLM may over-trust short-term simulated improvements or misinterpret noisy feedback. Therefore, the key challenge is not only to build a simulator, but to train an agent that can use simulated patient responses correctly.

为此，我们介绍To this end, we introduce败血症代理SepsisAgent，一种用于脓毒症治疗推荐的世界模型增强法学硕士药剂。 SepsisAgent 遵循建议-模拟-完善的工作流程：它提出候选液体-升压药干预措施，查询临床世界模型以了解模拟患者的反应，并使用模拟反馈和临床先验完善其最终处方。我们通过三阶段课程进一步培训代理人。首先，监督微调教授患者动态预测和指南感知的一步推理。其次，行为克隆教授与世界模型的多轮交互。第三，基于世界模型的代理强化学习通过模拟状态-行动-结果反馈来优化长期治疗策略。, a world model-augmented LLM agent for sepsis treatment recommendation. SepsisAgent follows a propose–simulate–refine workflow: it proposes candidate fluid–vasopressor interventions, queries the Clinical World Model for simulated patient responses, and refines its final prescription using both simulated feedback and clinical priors. We further train the agent through a three-stage curriculum. First, supervised fine-tuning teaches patient-dynamics prediction and guideline-aware one-step reasoning. Second, behavior cloning teaches multi-round interaction with the world model. Third, world-model-based agentic reinforcement learning optimizes long-horizon treatment strategies through simulated state–action–outcome feedback.

我们的贡献总结如下：Our contributions are summarized as follows:

  • •

    用于脓毒症治疗的世界模型增强法学硕士药剂。A world model-augmented LLM agent for sepsis treatment.我们建议We propose败血症代理SepsisAgent，一种基于法学硕士的治疗剂，与临床世界模型合作，在处方前比较候选液体-血管加压药干预措施。 SepsisAgent 在 MIMIC-IV 脓毒症轨迹上优于所有传统的基于 RL 和 LLM 的基线。, an LLM-based treatment agent that collaborates with a Clinical World Model to compare candidate fluid–vasopressor interventions before prescription. SepsisAgent outperforms all traditional RL and LLM-based baselines on MIMIC-IV sepsis trajectories.

  • •

    基于世界模型的多阶段训练范例。A world-model-based multi-stage training paradigm.我们表明，仅仅让法学硕士接触世界模型是不够的。因此，我们通过基于临床世界模型的多阶段代理学习管道来训练 SepsisAgent，提高其解释模拟患者反应和优化治疗策略的能力。We show that merely giving LLMs access to a world model is insufficient. We therefore train SepsisAgent through a multi-stage agentic learning pipeline based on the Clinical World Model, improving its ability to interpret simulated patient responses and optimize treatment policies.

  • •

    将患者动态内在化为法学硕士。Internalizing patient dynamics within LLMs.我们的实验表明，基于世界模型的代理强化学习增强了法学硕士预测脓毒症患者动态的内在能力，而不仅仅是拟合奖励信号。即使没有模拟器访问，SepsiAgent 也可以提高对院内死亡率和升压药需求的预测。Our experiments show that world-model-based agentic reinforcement learning enhances the LLM’s intrinsic ability to predict patient dynamics in sepsis, rather than merely fitting the reward signal. SepsisAgent improves prediction of in-hospital mortality and vasopressor requirement even without simulator access.

2 迈向世界模型增强脓毒症药剂Towards World Model Augmented Sepsis Agent

2.1 问题定义Problem Definition

人工智能代理越来越多地用于支持医疗决策。在这项工作中，我们重点关注脓毒症治疗，这是一项具有挑战性的 ICU 任务，其特点是感染引起的器官功能障碍迅速恶化AI agents are increasingly used to support healthcare decision-making. In this work, we focus on sepsis treatment, a challenging ICU task characterized by rapidly worsening organ dysfunction caused by infectionSinger et al. (2016)。先前的研究将脓毒症治疗制定为离散马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP). Following prior studies that formulate sepsis treatment as a discrete Markov Decision Process (MDP)Komorowski et al. (2018); Raghu et al. (2017)，我们将此任务建模为顺序决策问题。在每个决策步骤, we model this task as a sequential decision-making problem. At each decision steptt，代理观察当前患者状态, the agent observes the current patient statest∈𝒮s_{t}\in\mathcal{S}，由人口统计、生理、实验室和治疗历史变量表示，并选择治疗行动, represented by demographic, physiological, laboratory, and treatment-history variables, and selects a treatment actionat∈𝒜a_{t}\in\mathcal{A}.

遵循既往脓毒症 RL 配方Following prior sepsis RL formulationsWu et al. (2023); Kalimouttou et al. (2025)，我们的行动空间涵盖了两种关键的可控血流动力学干预措施：静脉输液和血管加压药的使用，并将这些干预措施按剂量水平离散化为, our action space covers two key controllable hemodynamic interventions: intravenous fluid administration and vasopressor use, and discretizes these interventions by dosage levels into a5×55\times 5网格：grid:

𝒜=𝒜fluid×𝒜vaso.\mathcal{A}=\mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{fluid}}\times\mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{vaso}}.

该药物旨在推荐治疗措施，稳定短期患者的生理机能，同时改善长期临床结果。The agent aims to recommend treatment actions that stabilize short-term patient physiology while improving long-term clinical outcomes.

2.2 引入临床世界模型的动机Motivation to Introduce Clinical World Model

大多数现有方法直接从回顾性 EHR 轨迹中学习治疗策略，将当前患者状态映射到治疗行动Most prior methods learn treatment policies directly from retrospective EHR trajectories, mapping the current patient state to a treatment actionLiu et al. (2020)。此类策略主要学习观察到的状态与历史临床医生行为之间的关联。因此，他们很容易受到历史行为偏见的影响，并且推理观察数据中很少涵盖的替代治疗路径的能力有限. Such policies mainly learn associations between observed states and historical clinician actions. They are therefore vulnerable to historical behavior bias and have limited ability to reason about alternative treatment paths that are poorly covered in observational dataXu et al. (2025a)。然而，脓毒症治疗不仅仅是针对当前状态选择行动；而是针对当前状态选择行动。它还需要估计患者在不同干预措施下可能如何发展. However, sepsis treatment is not only about selecting an action for the current state; it also requires estimating how the patient may evolve under different interventionsRaghu et al. (2018).

这激发了患者反应的明确模型。在基于模型的强化学习中，世界模型近似环境动态并通过预测候选动作下的未来状态来支持规划This motivates an explicit model of patient response. In model-based reinforcement learning, a world model approximates environment dynamics and supports planning by predicting future states under candidate actionsHa and Schmidhuber (2018); LeCun and others (2022)。在这部作品中，. In this work,我们将临床世界模型定义为患者动态的学习的、以行动为条件的近似值we define a Clinical World Model as a learned, action-conditioned approximation of patient dynamics:

Wθ:(st,at)↦pθ​(st+1,ot∣st,at),W_{\theta}:(s_{t},a_{t})\mapsto p_{\theta}(s_{t+1},o_{t}\mid s_{t},a_{t}),

哪里wherests_{t}是当前患者状态表示，is the current patient state representation,ata_{t}是候选治疗动作，并且is a candidate treatment action, andoto_{t}表示下游临床结果。对于脓毒症治疗，该模型充当近似模拟器，预测液体升压药干预的生理后果，使代理人能够在开具处方之前比较候选行动。denotes downstream clinical outcomes. For sepsis treatment, this model acts as an approximate simulator that predicts the physiological consequences of fluid–vasopressor interventions, enabling the agent to compare candidate actions before making a prescription.

2.3 解决方案：世界模型增强脓毒症药剂Solution: World Model-Augmented Sepsis Agent

法学硕士和临床世界模型解决治疗决策问题的不同部分。法学硕士提供语义层：它们对临床先验知识进行编码，解释不同的患者背景，对指南进行推理，并为治疗决策生成可解释的基本原理LLMs and Clinical World Models address different parts of the treatment-decision problem. LLMs provide the semantic layer: they encode clinical prior knowledge, interpret heterogeneous patient context, reason over guidelines, and generate interpretable rationales for treatment decisionsSinghal et al. (2023, 2025); Tu et al. (2025)。然而，它们并没有直接模拟特定干预后特定患者状态将如何演变. However, they do not directly model how a specific patient state will evolve after a specific interventionSteinberg et al. (2023); Wornow et al. (2024)。临床世界模型提供了动态层：它们预测候选治疗下患者的行动条件反应，但缺乏法学硕士的临床语义推理和指南意识判断。. Clinical World Models provide the dynamics layer: they predict action-conditioned patient responses under candidate treatments, but lack the clinical semantic reasoning and guideline-aware judgment of LLMs.

为了结合这些优势，我们建议To combine these strengths, we propose败血症代理SepsisAgent，一种用于脓毒症治疗推荐的世界模型增强法学硕士药剂。 LLM 骨干充当决策政策，而临床世界模型充当代理组件，通过预测候选干预下患者的反应来与 LLM 合作。此外，世界模型提供了反事实探索轨迹，用于进一步训练 SepsisAgent 以了解患者动态并优化治疗策略。, a world model-augmented LLM agent for sepsis treatment recommendation. The LLM backbone acts as the decision-making policy, while the Clinical World Model acts as an agent component that collaborates with the LLM by predicting patient responses under candidate interventions. Moreover, the world model provides counterfactual exploration trajectories, which are used to further train SepsisAgent to understand patient dynamics and optimize treatment strategies.

在推理时，SepsiAgent 遵循建议-模拟-优化工作流程。鉴于目前患者的状态At inference time, SepsisAgent follows a propose–simulate–refine workflow. Given the current patient statests_{t}，LLM提出候选行动集, the LLM proposes a candidate action set

𝒞t={at(1),…,at(M)}.\mathcal{C}_{t}=\{a_{t}^{(1)},\dots,a_{t}^{(M)}\}.

对于每个候选动作，临床世界模型都会估计其可能的生理后果：For each candidate action, the Clinical World Model estimates its possible physiological consequence:

y^t(i)∼Wθ​(st,at(i)),\hat{y}_{t}^{(i)}\sim W_{\theta}(s_{t},a_{t}^{(i)}),

哪里wherey^t(i)\hat{y}_{t}^{(i)}总结了预测的患者反应，包括未来的生理状态和结果相关信号。然后，法学硕士将这些行动-反应对与其临床先验进行比较，并致力于最终治疗：summarizes the predicted patient response, including future physiological state and outcome-related signals. The LLM then compares these action–response pairs with its clinical priors and commits to the final treatment:

at=πϕ​(st,{(at(i),y^t(i))}i=1M).a_{t}=\pi_{\phi}\left(s_{t},\{(a_{t}^{(i)},\hat{y}_{t}^{(i)})\}_{i=1}^{M}\right).

在此配方的基础上，Building on this formulation,第 3 节实例化临床世界模型并评估其对 SepsisAgent 的益处Section 3 instantiates the Clinical World Model and evaluates its benefit for SepsisAgent. 第 4 节随后描述了 SepsisAgent 如何在这个世界模型中探索和学习Section 4 then describes how SepsisAgent explores and learns within this world model.

3 训练世界模型以增强败血症代理Training World Model to Augment Sepsis Agent

本节构建临床世界模型，该模型既充当推理时间模拟器又充当 SepsisAgent 的培训环境。我们首先从 MIMIC-IV 构建离散脓毒症轨迹，然后实例化患者动态的动作条件预测模型，最后This section builds the Clinical World Model that serves as both the inference-time simulator and the training environment for SepsisAgent. The results show that the model captures clinical relevant patient dynamics and provides informative short-horizon feedback for candidate treatment actions.

3.3 为什么仅访问世界模型是不够的Why World-Model Access Alone Is Insufficient

这一观察结果将焦点从让法学硕士访问世界模型转移到训练可以使用世界模型反馈的代理。在第 4 节中，我们将模拟的患者反应转化为学习信号：SepsiAgent 经过训练，可以了解不断变化的患者动态、根据脓毒症指南先例进行推理，并通过与临床世界模型的重复交互来完善治疗策略。This observation shifts the focus from giving an LLM access to a world model to training an agent that can use world-model feedback. In Section 4, we turn simulated patient responses into learning signals: SepsisAgent is trained to understand evolving patient dynamics, reason under sepsis guideline priors, and refine treatment policies through repeated interaction with the Clinical World Model.

4 通过世界模型交互代理患者动态Agentifying Patient Dynamics in Agents through World Model Interaction

4.1 从世界模型反馈到患者动态理解From World Model Feedback to Patient-Dynamics Understanding

训练目标。Training goal.

部分Section3.3表明瓶颈不是模拟器的访问，而是代理解释患者动态反馈并将其与临床先验整合的能力。从临床决策的角度来看，有用的代理不应简单地遵循具有最佳一步模拟响应的行动。它应该首先了解患者不断变化的风险，然后推理出符合指南的治疗选择，最后通过反事实的患者反应估计来完善决策。因此，我们不仅使用临床世界模型作为推理时间模拟器，而且还作为使法学硕士接触重复的状态-行动-结果反馈的培训环境。shows that the bottleneck is not simulator access, but the agent’s ability to interpret patient-dynamics feedback and integrate it with clinical priors. From a clinical decision-making perspective, a useful agent should not simply follow the action with the best one-step simulated response. It should first understand the patient’s evolving risk, then reason about guideline-consistent treatment choices, and finally refine decisions through counterfactual patient-response estimates. We therefore use the Clinical World Model not only as an inference-time simulator, but also as a training environment that exposes the LLM to repeated state–action–outcome feedback.

课程设计。Curriculum design.

这激发了分阶段的课程，如图所示This motivates a staged curriculum, shown in Figure3。第一阶段通过监督数据建立患者动态理解和指南感知治疗推理，这些数据共同包括 IHM 预测、VR 预测和一步治疗建议。第二阶段通过对合成交互轨迹的模仿学习来教授与世界模型的多轮交互。第三阶段通过世界模型环境中的强化学习进一步优化智能体，鼓励长期规划而不是贪婪的短期稳定。. Stage I builds patient-dynamics understanding and guideline-aware treatment reasoning through supervised data that jointly includes IHM prediction, VR prediction, and one-step treatment recommendation. Stage II teaches multi-turn interaction with the world model through imitation learning on synthesized interaction trajectories. Stage III further optimizes the agent through reinforcement learning in the world-model environment, encouraging long-horizon planning rather than greedy short-term stabilization.

4.2 第一阶段：患者动态预测和指南感知推理Stage I: Patient-Dynamics Prediction and Guideline-Aware Reasoning

动态感知监督。Dynamics-aware supervision.

我们围绕 MIMIC-Sepsis 基准中定义的两个预测任务构建监督训练数据We construct supervised training data around two prediction tasks defined in the MIMIC-Sepsis benchmarkHuang et al. (2025)：院内死亡率 (IHM) 和升压药需求 (VR)。这些任务对于治疗选择至关重要，因为它们反映了患者的长期结果和血流动力学恶化。: in-hospital mortality (IHM) and vasopressor requirement (VR). These tasks are critical for treatment selection, as they capture long-term patient outcome and hemodynamic deterioration.

院内死亡率。In-hospital mortality.

考虑到当前患者的情况和治疗信息，该模型将患者随后的院内死亡率预测为二元结果。这项任务鼓励模型关注治疗轨迹的长期后果，而不仅仅是即时的生理测量。Given the current patient context and treatment information, the model predicts the patient’s subsequent in-hospital mortality as a binary outcome. This task encourages the model to attend to the long-term consequences of treatment trajectories rather than only immediate physiological measurements.

升压药的需求。Vasopressor requirement.

VR 任务预测患者在接下来的 24 小时内是否需要血管加压药支持。基于脓毒症指南The VR task predicts whether the patient will require vasopressor support within the next 24 hours. Based on sepsis guidelinesEvans et al. (2021)，VR 作为具有临床意义的代理，用于预测关键生理指标是否会在未来 24 小时内跨越高风险临床阈值。, VR serves as a clinically meaningful proxy for predicting whether key physiological indicators will cross high-risk clinical thresholds within the next 24 hours.

一步治疗推理。One-step treatment reasoning.

我们训练模型以执行基于患者动态和脓毒症指南先验的单步治疗推理。每个示例都遵循一个We train the model to perform single-step treatment reasoning grounded in patient dynamics and sepsis guideline priors. Each example follows an分析-决策Analysis–Decision格式：在format: in the分析Analysis阶段，模型预测 IHM 和 VR，并根据脓毒症指南先验评估患者的病情；在phase, the model predicts IHM and VR and evaluates the patient’s condition under sepsis guideline priors; in the决定Decision阶段，它会建议相应的离散治疗行动。这种设计使两个动态预测任务成为治疗推理过程的一部分，而不是孤立的辅助目标。phase, it recommends the corresponding discrete treatment action. This design makes the two dynamics-prediction tasks part of the treatment reasoning process rather than isolated auxiliary objectives.

推理数据构建。Reasoning data construction.

遵循构建医学推理监督的常见做法Following common practice in constructing medical reasoning supervisionChen et al. (2024b); Sun et al. (2025)，我们使用 GPT-4.1 从观察到的临床事实、专家行动和脓毒症指南先验中综合思想链式的基本原理。生成的轨迹被重新格式化为结构化监督对，使模型能够学习患者状态分析和符合指南的一步治疗建议。, we use GPT-4.1 to synthesize chain-of-thought-style rationales from observed clinical facts, expert actions, and sepsis guideline priors. The generated traces are reformatted into structured supervision pairs, enabling the model to learn patient-state analysis and guideline-consistent one-step treatment recommendation.

4.3 第二阶段：提出-模拟-完善行为克隆Stage II: Propose–Simulate–Refine Behavior Cloning

工作流程模仿。Workflow imitation.

在第一阶段之后，该模型已经学会了非代理患者动态预测和指南感知的一步推理。第二阶段教导模型如何在决策过程中使用世界模型反馈：在实施每个治疗行动之前，智能体可以多轮查询临床世界模型，检查模拟结果，并完善其最终处方。After Stage I, the model has learned non-agentic patient-dynamics prediction and guideline-aware one-step reasoning. Stage II teaches the model how to use world-model feedback during decision-making: before committing to each treatment action, the agent can query the Clinical World Model for multiple rounds, inspect simulated consequences, and refine its final prescription.

轨迹合成。Trajectory synthesis.

对于每个专家过渡For each expert transition(st,at∗)(s_{t},a_{t}^{*})，我们使用 GPT-4.1 按照 2.3 节中的交互来合成多轮提议-模拟-细化推理轨迹。追踪从患者状态开始, we use GPT-4.1 to synthesize a multi-round propose–simulate–refine reasoning trace following the interaction in Section 2.3. The trace starts from the patient statests_{t}，提出候选行动, proposes candidate actions𝒞t\mathcal{C}_{t}，获得模拟响应, obtains simulated responses{y^t(i)}i=1M\{\hat{y}_{t}^{(i)}\}_{i=1}^{M}从临床世界模型中，根据这些响应选择性地更新候选集，最后选择专家操作from the Clinical World Model, optionally updates the candidate set based on these responses, and finally selects the expert actionat∗a_{t}^{*}.

行为克隆目标。Behavior cloning objective.

我们对模型进行微调以重现这些结构化的多轮轨迹。此阶段为世界模型交互提供了一个冷启动，使智能体能够在第三阶段的强化学习之前了解模拟患者反应如何为治疗建议提供信息。We fine-tune the model to reproduce these structured multi-round traces. This stage provides a cold start for world-model interaction, enabling the agent to learn how simulated patient responses should inform treatment recommendations before reinforcement learning in Stage III.

4.4 第三阶段：基于世界模型的代理强化学习Stage III: World-Model-Based Agentic RL

长期优化。Long-horizon optimization.

行为克隆为提议-模拟-完善决策提供了冷启动，但仍然受到专家演示的限制。在第三阶段，我们通过组相关策略优化（GRPO）进一步优化策略Behavior cloning provides a cold start for propose–simulate–refine decision-making, but remains constrained by expert demonstrations. In Stage III, we further optimize the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)Shao et al. (2024a)。该代理与作为虚拟环境的临床世界模型进行交互，对每个患者状态的多个推理轨迹进行采样，并学习选择能够改善患者长期结果的行动，而不仅仅是模仿观察到的决策。. The agent interacts with the Clinical World Model as a virtual environment, samples multiple reasoning trajectories for each patient state, and learns to select actions that improve long-term patient outcomes rather than merely imitate observed decisions.

世界模型的推出。World-model rollouts.

对于每个初始患者状态For each initial patient states0s_{0}, 政策, the policyπϕ\pi_{\phi}通过多轮世界模型交互生成治疗动作。然后，临床世界模型推出最终的患者轨迹generates treatment actions through multi-round world-model interaction. The Clinical World Model then rolls out the resulting patient trajectory

τ={(s0,a0),(s1,a1),…,(sT,aT)},\tau=\{(s_{0},a_{0}),(s_{1},a_{1}),\ldots,(s_{T},a_{T})\},

其中每个转变都是由所选治疗动作下的模拟患者反应引起的。这使得代理能够接收来自完整治疗轨迹的反馈，而不仅仅是单步专家标签。where each transition is induced by the simulated patient response under the selected treatment action. This allows the agent to receive feedback from complete treatment trajectories, rather than only single-step expert labels.

复合奖励。Composite reward.

我们使用综合奖励来优化策略，该奖励结合了最终结果、中间生理稳定性和指南一致性：We optimize the policy using a composite reward that combines terminal outcome, intermediate physiological stabilization, and guideline consistency:

R​(τ)=Rout​(sT)+∑t=0T−1r​(st,st+1)−λg​𝒫g​(τ).R(\tau)=R_{\mathrm{out}}(s_{T})+\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}r(s_{t},s_{t+1})-\lambda_{g}\mathcal{P}_{g}(\tau).

在这里，Here,RoutR_{\mathrm{out}}奖励有利的最终结果，例如生存并惩罚死亡率，而rewards favorable terminal outcomes such as survival and penalizes mortality, while𝒫g\mathcal{P}_{g}惩罚违反脓毒症指南限制的行为。penalizes violations of sepsis guideline constraints.

中级奖励。Intermediate reward.

遵循 DDQN 脓毒症治疗的中间奖励设计Following the intermediate reward design in DDQN for sepsis treatmentRaghu et al. (2017)，我们将逐步的生理奖励定义为, we define the step-wise physiological reward as

r​(st,st+1)=C0​𝕀​(Δ​SOFAt=0∧st+1SOFA>0)+C1​Δ​SOFAt+C2​Δ​Lact.r(s_{t},s_{t+1})=C_{0}\mathbb{I}(\Delta\mathrm{SOFA}_{t}=0\land s_{t+1}^{\mathrm{SOFA}}>0)+C_{1}\Delta\mathrm{SOFA}_{t}+C_{2}\Delta\mathrm{Lac}_{t}.

该术语鼓励改善器官功能障碍和乳酸动态，而终末奖励则鼓励长期生存。附录中提供了详细的奖励系数、乳酸转化、裁剪策略和实施细节This term encourages improvement in organ dysfunction and lactate dynamics, while the terminal reward encourages long-term survival. Detailed reward coefficients, lactate transformation, clipping strategy, and implementation details are provided in AppendixG.2.

5 实验Experiments

5.1 实验装置Experimental Setup

骨干选择。Backbone selection.

我们选择Qwen3-4B-InstructWe select Qwen3-4B-InstructYang et al. (2025)作为 SepsisAgent 的支柱。它足以支持临床推理和代理交互，同时保持高效的部署式评估：训练后，每个决策步骤的平均推理时间为 6.1 秒，完全符合 ICU 脓毒症管理的分钟级决策流程。as the backbone of SepsisAgent. It is sufficiently capable of supporting clinical reasoning and agentic interaction, while remaining efficient for deployment-style evaluation: after training, the average inference time per decision step is 6.1s, well within the minutes-scale decision workflow of ICU sepsis management.

基线。Baselines.

我们将 SepsisAgent 与四组基线进行比较。We compare SepsisAgent with four groups of baselines.临床医生Clinicians对应于 MIMIC-IV 测试集中记录的人类决策，并作为现实世界的参考策略。correspond to the recorded human decisions in the MIMIC-IV test set and serve as the real-world reference policy.传统强化学习Traditional RL基线包括代表性脓毒症治疗政策、DDQNbaselines include representative sepsis treatment policies, DDQNRaghu et al. (2017)和人工智能临床医生and AI ClinicianKomorowski et al. (2018). 普通法学硕士Vanilla LLMs评估通用语言模型是否可以在没有世界模型反馈的情况下直接从患者状态推荐败血症治疗。evaluate whether general-purpose language models can recommend sepsis treatments directly from patient states without world-model feedback.世界模型增强法学硕士World-model-augmented LLMs使用与 SepsisAgent 相同的临床世界模型并提出-模拟-完善交互协议，但不接受我们的分阶段监督和强化学习培训。这种比较将代理训练的效果与仅仅提供世界模型访问的效果区分开来。use the same Clinical World Model and propose–simulate–refine interaction protocol as SepsisAgent, but do not receive our staged supervised and reinforcement learning training. This comparison isolates the effect of agent training from merely providing world-model access.

评估指标。Evaluation metrics.

我们从三个互补的角度评估了 725 集测试集上的每种方法。We evaluate each method on the 725-episode held-out test set from three complementary perspectives.离政策评估Off-policy evaluation报告灾难恢复reports DRJiang and Li (2016)、WIS 和 WPDIS, WIS, and WPDISPrecup et al. 5.2 主要结果：SepsisAgent 在保证安全的同时提高了政策价值Main Results: SepsisAgent Improves Policy Value While Preserving Safety

表Table3总结了 SepsisAgent 的性能以及 725 集测试集上的所有基线。summarizes the performance of SepsisAgent and all baselines on the 725-episode test set.

SepsisAgent 实现了最强的政策外价值。SepsisAgent achieves the strongest off-policy value.

SepsisAgent 在所有方法中获得了最佳 DR 和 WPDIS 分数，同时在 WIS 上保持竞争力。它的性能优于传统的 RL 和基于 LLM 的策略，并且在所有三个 OPE 估计器中持续改进其基本模型。这表明我们的分阶段培训流程受益于法学硕士的临床先验知识，同时进一步提高治疗政策质量。SepsisAgent obtains the best DR and WPDIS scores among all methods, while remaining competitive on WIS. It outperforms both traditional RL and LLM-based policies, and also improves consistently over its base model across all three OPE estimators. This suggests that our staged training pipeline benefits from the LLM’s clinical prior knowledge while further improving treatment policy quality.

SepsisAgent 实现了最佳的安全性。SepsisAgent achieves the best safety profile.

SepsisAgent 实现了最高的脓毒症指南遵守率和最低的不安全行动率，表明该药物不会通过采取不安全的治疗捷径来提高估计的政策价值。传统的 RL 政策往往会产生更极端的过量行为。临床医生的行为更加保守，但仍可能包含次优的剂量不足模式，这与脓毒症治疗实践中的先前观察结果一致SepsisAgent achieves the highest sepsis guideline adherence and the lowest unsafe-action rates, indicating that the agent does not improve estimated policy value by taking unsafe treatment shortcuts. Traditional RL policies tend to produce more extreme overdosing actions. Clinician behavior is more conservative, but can still contain suboptimal underdosing patterns, consistent with prior observations in sepsis treatment practiceWu et al. (2023); Festor et al. (2022).

培训的重要性超出了世界模式的范畴。Training matters beyond world-model access.

世界模型增强的法学硕士比许多普通的法学硕士基线有所改进，但它们仍然低于 SepsisAgent。这表明仅模拟患者反应是不够的。代理必须经过培训才能解释动态反馈并将其与临床安全约束保持一致。World-model-augmented LLMs improve over many vanilla LLM baselines, but they still fall short of SepsisAgent. This suggests that simulated patient responses alone are not enough. The agent must be trained to interpret dynamics feedback and align it with clinical safety constraints.

5.3 消融研究：强化学习推动政策改进Ablation Study: RL Drives Policy Improvement

表Table4报告每个训练阶段的累积效果。 OPE结果表明，政策价值的改善主要来自RL阶段。 SFT 和行为克隆改进了一些指标，但并未在 DR、WIS 和 WPDIS 中产生稳定的收益。安全指标更早得到改善：第一阶段和第二阶段已经教会模型在脓毒症指南和专家定义的安全边界内进行推理。第三阶段进一步改善了这两个安全指标，表明临床世界模型提供了有效的强化学习训练环境，可以优化长期治疗价值，同时保持临床安全行为。reports the cumulative effect of each training stage. The OPE results show that policy-value improvement mainly comes from the RL stage. SFT and behavior cloning improve some metrics, but do not yield stable gains across DR, WIS, and WPDIS. The safety metrics improve earlier: Stage I and Stage II already teach the model to reason within sepsis guideline and expert-defined safety boundaries. Stage III further improves both safety metrics, suggesting that the Clinical World Model provides an effective RL training environment for optimizing long-horizon treatment value while preserving clinically safe behavior.

5.4 分析：法学硕士内化患者动态Analysis: Internalizing Patient Dynamics within LLMs

我们通过评估 IHM 和 VR 预测来测试 SepsisAgent 是否内化患者动态，而无需访问临床世界模型。如表所示We test whether SepsisAgent internalizes patient dynamics by evaluating IHM and VR prediction without access to the Clinical World Model. As shown in Table4，Stage III 实现了最佳的 IHM AUPRC 和最佳的 VR AUROC/AUPRC，同时保持了具有竞争力的 IHM AUROC。这表明基于世界模型的代理强化学习提高了法学硕士预测患者结果和未来血管加压药需求的内在能力。因此，智能体不仅要适应奖励信号，还要适应奖励信号。与临床世界模型的重复交互有助于它了解患者动态规律，即使在模拟器访问被移除时，这些规律仍然有用。, Stage III achieves the best IHM AUPRC and the best VR AUROC/AUPRC, while maintaining competitive IHM AUROC. This suggests that world-model-based agentic RL improves the LLM’s intrinsic ability to predict patient outcomes and future vasopressor needs. The agent therefore does not merely fit the reward signal; repeated interaction with the Clinical World Model helps it learn patient-dynamics regularities that remain useful even when simulator access is removed.

6 结论Conclusion

我们提出了We presented败血症代理SepsisAgent，一种用于脓毒症治疗推荐的世界模型增强法学硕士药剂。 SepsisAgent 使用临床世界模型来比较反事实治疗反应并完善液体升压药处方。我们的结果表明，对于通用法学硕士来说，仅访问世界模型是不够的，因此需要分阶段的培训流程，教会代理人解释模拟的患者动态并将其与临床先验保持一致。在 MIMIC-IV 脓毒症轨迹上，SepsisAgent 在传统 RL 和基于 LLM 的基线中实现了最强的政策外价值和最佳的安全性。消融研究进一步表明，基于世界模型的强化学习在保证安全性的同时推动了政策价值的提高。最后，内在预测结果表明，与临床世界模型的重复交互有助于法学硕士内化患者动态，即使在没有模拟器访问的情况下也能改善死亡率和升压药需求预测。这些发现为使用基于世界模型的代理学习来支持高敏锐度环境中的顺序临床决策提供了概念证明。, a world model-augmented LLM agent for sepsis treatment recommendation. SepsisAgent uses a Clinical World Model to compare counterfactual treatment responses and refine fluid–vasopressor prescriptions. Our results show that world-model access alone is insufficient for generic LLMs, motivating a staged training pipeline that teaches the agent to interpret simulated patient dynamics and align them with clinical priors. On MIMIC-IV sepsis trajectories, SepsisAgent achieves the strongest off-policy value and the best safety profile among traditional RL and LLM-based baselines. Ablation studies further show that world-model-based RL drives policy-value improvement while preserving safety. Finally, intrinsic prediction results indicate that repeated interaction with the Clinical World Model helps the LLM internalize patient dynamics, improving mortality and vasopressor-requirement prediction even without simulator access. These findings provide a proof of concept for using world-model-based agentic learning to support sequential clinical decision-making in high-acuity settings.

A.1 使用世界模型的 LLM 代理LLM Agent Using a World Model

脓毒症治疗涉及复杂且患者特定的血流动力学动力学，目前在高危临床环境中的实践已知不是最理想的Sepsis treatment involves complex and patient-specific hemodynamic dynamics, and current practices in high-acuity clinical settings are known to be suboptimal[25]。患者反应的异质性和随时间变化的性质使得仅使用静态临床指南很难确定最佳干预措施. The heterogeneous and temporally evolving nature of patient responses makes it difficult to determine optimal interventions using static clinical guidelines alone[42, 13].

为了应对这一挑战，我们从基于模型的强化学习中的世界模型概念中汲取灵感To address this challenge, we draw inspiration from the notion of world models in model-based reinforcement learning[11, 20]并将其实例化为患者生理学的预测模拟器。在我们的框架中，法学硕士充当决策代理，并在行动选择期间查询临床世界模型。给定候选治疗策略，世界模型提供了脓毒症患者短期生理反应的近似模拟。这些预测信息补充了法学硕士的临床推理，并支持更明智的治疗决策。and instantiate it as a predictive simulator of patient physiology. In our framework, an LLM serves as the decision-making agent and queries the Clinical World Model during action selection. Given candidate treatment strategies, the world model provides approximate simulations of short-term physiological responses in sepsis patients. This predictive information complements the LLM’s clinical reasoning and supports more informed treatment decisions.

A.2 基于模型的代理强化学习Model-based Agentic Reinforcement Learning

基于模型的强化学习已被广泛探索用于治疗推荐Model-based reinforcement learning has been widely explored for treatment recommendation[49, 32, 28]，因为它可以通过患者动态的显式建模和模拟推广来实现策略优化。与无模型方法相比, as it enables policy optimization through explicit modeling of patient dynamics and simulated rollouts. Compared to model-free approaches[22, 8, 23]，基于模型的方法提高了样本效率，并能够在现实世界交互不可行的情况下推理治疗决策的后果。, model-based methods offer improved sample efficiency and the ability to reason about the consequences of treatment decisions in settings where real-world interaction is not feasible.

在此范式的基础上，我们进一步构建了临床世界模型作为培训法学硕士政策的虚拟环境。在此环境中，法学硕士执行治疗决策的模拟推广并观察由此产生的生理轨迹Building on this paradigm, we further construct the Clinical World Model as a virtual environment for training the LLM policy. Within this environment, the LLM performs simulated rollouts of treatment decisions and observes the resulting physiological trajectories[49, 32, 17].

通过与世界模型的反复交互，法学硕士可以通过将模拟反馈纳入其决策过程来超越纯粹的监督模仿。这种表述不是将模型预测视为预言，而是允许策略结合其临床先验来推理预测轨迹。此外，基于模型的设置自然支持多个时间步骤的决策，有助于考虑短期生理反应和长期临床目标。Through repeated interaction with the world model, the LLM can move beyond purely supervised imitation by incorporating simulated feedback into its decision process. Rather than treating model predictions as an oracle, this formulation allows the policy to reason over predicted trajectories in conjunction with its clinical priors. Moreover, the model-based setup naturally supports decision-making over multiple time steps, facilitating the consideration of both short-term physiological responses and longer-term clinical objectives.

附录BAppendix B影响报告Impact Statement

本文提出的研究旨在推进顺序决策的机器学习方法。虽然所提出的方法是由临床决策支持推动的，但它仅使用回顾性数据和模拟环境进行评估，并不适合直接临床部署。与机器学习在医疗保健领域的许多应用一样，存在与模型不确定性、数据偏差以及适当的人类监督的需要相关的潜在社会和伦理考虑，我们认为这里不需要进一步讨论。This paper presents research aimed at advancing machine learning methods for sequential decision-making. While the proposed approach is motivated by clinical decision support, it is evaluated solely using retrospective data and simulated environments and is not intended for direct clinical deployment. As with many applications of machine learning in healthcare, there are potential societal and ethical considerations related to model uncertainty, data bias, and the need for appropriate human oversight, which we do not believe require further discussion here.

附录CAppendix C局限性Limitations

本研究仅出于学术研究目的而进行。本文提出的模拟结果和模型不适用于现实世界的临床决策。任何潜在的临床使用只能在医生的监督下进行。This study is conducted solely for academic research purposes. The simulation results and models presented in this paper are not intended for real-world clinical decision-making. Any potential clinical use should be conducted only under the supervision of doctors.

E.1 架构细节Architecture Details

我们使用 PyTorch 实现临床世界模型。该框架由一个共享时间编码器组成，该编码器提取状态转换建模和结果预测的联合表示。We implement the Clinical World Model using PyTorch. The framework consists of a shared temporal encoder that extracts joint representations for both state transition modeling and outcome prediction.

To prevent overfitting, a dropout rate of 0.2 is applied between the GRU layers. The encoder takes a concatenated input of dynamic features, missingness masks, embedded static features (32-dimensional), and embedded treatment actions (32-dimensional).

我们比较了临床世界模型的四种候选架构：Transformer、LSTM、2 层 GRU 和 8 层 GRU。表We compare four candidate architectures for the Clinical World Model: Transformer, LSTM, 2-layer GRU, and 8-layer GRU. Table9报告世界模型本身的预测性能，而表reports predictive performance of the world models themselves, while Table10报告使用每个相应的世界模型训练的 SepsisAgent 的离策略评估结果。reports the off-policy evaluation results of SepsisAgent trained with each corresponding world model.

表格Tables9和and10结果表明，Transformer 世界模型在所有指标上都实现了最佳预测性能，但用它训练的 SepsisAgent 并未表现出与循环世界模型相比一致的 OPE 优势。尽管如此，我们观察到更准确的世界模型往往会带来更好的 DR 和 WIS 改进，这表明未来具有更高预测保真度的临床世界模型可能会进一步有利于 SepsisAgent。由于 2 层 GRU 世界模型已经足以让 SepsisAgent 超越主要实验中的所有基线，因此我们采用这种简化的架构来简化概念验证。show that the Transformer world model achieves the best predictive performance across all metrics, but SepsisAgent trained with it does not show a consistent OPE advantage over recurrent world models. Nevertheless, we observe that more accurate world models tend to bring better DR and WIS improvements, suggesting that future Clinical World Models with higher predictive fidelity may further benefit SepsisAgent. Since the 2-layer GRU world model is already sufficient for SepsisAgent to outperform all baselines in the main experiments, we adopt this simplified architecture for proof-of-concept simplicity.

败血症指南先验。Sepsis guideline priors.

我们使用以下源自以下脓毒症指南的先验知识：We use the following sepsis guideline priors derived from the2021 年战胜败血症运动Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2021指导方针guidelines[9]及临床专家评审：and clinical expert review:

  • •

    败血症和败血性休克属于医疗紧急情况，应立即开始治疗和复苏。Sepsis and septic shock are medical emergencies, and treatment and resuscitation should begin immediately.

  • •

    对于脓毒症引起的低灌注或感染性休克的患者，复苏前3小时内应至少静脉注射30 mL/kg晶体液。For patients with sepsis-induced hypoperfusion or septic shock, at least 30 mL/kg of IV crystalloid fluid should be given within the first 3 hours of resuscitation.

  • •

  • •

    如果充分液体复苏后 MAP 仍低于 65 mmHg，则应启动血管加压药。Vasopressors should be initiated if MAP remains below 65 mmHg after adequate fluid resuscitation.

附录GAppendix G三阶段培训流程的详细信息Details of the Three-stage Training pipeline

本节详细描述了训练数据构建This section provide a detailed description of the training data construction for第一阶段Stage I和and第二阶段Stage II，然后是基于 GRPO 的代理强化学习过程。, followed by the GRPO-based agentic reinforcement learning procedure.

G.1 数据建设Data Construction

G.1.1 第一阶段Stage I训练数据Training Data

ICU 数据包含大量的数字状态信息。为了帮助法学硕士更好地理解和分析这些数据，我们引入了这个训练阶段并相应地构建了有针对性的训练数据。具体来说，每个数据实例由结构化的 ICU 临床信号组成ICU data contain a large amount of numerical state information. To help the LLM better understand and analyze such data in an aligned manner, we introduce this training stage and construct targeted training data accordingly. Specifically, each data instance consists of structured ICU clinical signals𝒮\mathcal{S}，包括固定时间窗口内的多变量生理和实验室测量，以及特定于任务的指令。训练数据的构建是通过提示 GPT-4.1 对相同的临床信号执行不同的指令驱动任务，从不同的角度进行分析，从而增强模型理解患者状态的能力。, including multivariate physiological and laboratory measurements over a fixed time window, together with a task-specific instruction. The training data are constructed by prompting GPT-4.1 to perform diverse instruction-driven tasks on the same clinical signals, producing analyses from different perspectives, thereby enhancing the model’s ability to understand patient states.

在第一阶段，我们利用强大的法学硕士教师在多个互补的临床任务下产生监督信号。每个数据实例为教师模型提供患者状态In Stage I, we leverage a strong teacher LLM to generate supervision signals under multiple complementary clinical tasks. Each data instance provides the teacher model with the patient state𝒮\mathcal{S}、相关临床指南, relevant clinical guidelinesgg，以及参考医生的行动, and reference physician actionsa∗a^{*}。针对具体任务的指导旨在提示教师从不同的临床角度分析相同的患者状态。. Task-specific instructions are designed to prompt the teacher to analyze the same patient state from different clinical perspectives.

具体来说，我们考虑三种类型的指令：Specifically, we consider three types of instructions:

  • •

    1) 状态分析State Analysis，要求教师模型综合患者当前的血流动力学状态（例如血压和心率）、灌注指标（例如乳酸和尿量），并评估对感染性休克临床定义的依从性；, which asks the teacher model to synthesize the patient’s current hemodynamic status (e.g., blood pressure and heart rate), perfusion indicators (e.g., lactate and urine output), and assess compliance with the clinical definition of septic shock;

  • •

    2) 患者动态Patient Dynamics，这要求教师推断时间趋势和疾病进展，包括院内死亡率，并可能在接下来的 24 小时内需要血管加压药；, which requires the teacher to reason about temporal trends and disease progression, including in-hospital mortality and likely to require vasopressors within the next 24 hours;

  • •

对于每种指令类型For each instruction typeqkq_{k}，教师模型根据完整的临床背景产生特定于任务的响应：, the teacher model produces a task-specific response conditioned on the full clinical context:

rk=TeacherLLM​(𝒮,g,a∗,qk),k∈{analysis,dynamics,decision}.r_{k}=\text{TeacherLLM}(\mathcal{S},g,a^{*},q_{k}),\quad k\in\{\text{analysis},\text{dynamics},\text{decision}\}.

最终的训练样本是通过使用固定模板连接所有任务响应来构建的，形成集成患者状态解释、时间推理和指南约束决策的统一监督信号。这些合成样本随后用于训练目标法学硕士，使其能够内化教师模型所展示的结构化和临床基础的推理模式。The final training sample is constructed by concatenating all task responses using a fixed template, forming a unified supervision signal that integrates patient state interpretation, temporal reasoning, and guideline-constrained decision making. These synthesized samples are subsequently used to train the target LLM, enabling it to internalize structured and clinically grounded reasoning patterns demonstrated by the teacher model.

G.1.2 第二阶段Stage II训练数据Training Data

代理模拟推理数据Agentic Simulation Reasoning Data

对于代理模拟推理数据，该指令要求法学硕士教师通过与临床世界模型的交互来迭代地推理患者状态。在每个时间步For agentic simulation reasoning data, the instruction requires the Teacher LLM to iteratively reason about patient states through interaction with a clinical world model. At each timesteptt，法学硕士教师接收当前患者状态, the Teacher LLM receives the current patient state𝒮t\mathcal{S}_{t}，面向模拟的指令, a simulation-oriented instructionqsimq_{\text{sim}}，以及指定一小组候选治疗操作的预定义模拟计划。法学硕士教师首先生成自由形式的临床推理并调用, and a predefined simulation plan specifying a small set of candidate treatment actions. The Teacher LLM first generates free-form clinical reasoning and invokes a模拟simulation查询世界模型的工具，该模型返回建议操作的预测未来状态：tool to query the world model, which returns predicted future states for the proposed actions:

{𝒮^t+1(i)}=𝒲​(𝒮t,{at(i)})\{\hat{\mathcal{S}}_{t+1}^{(i)}\}=\mathcal{W}(\mathcal{S}_{t},\{a_{t}^{(i)}\})

然后将返回的模拟结果纳入后续推理步骤，使法学硕士教师能够在做出最终决定之前通过多轮模拟完善其分析。该数据教导模型如何通过明确的教师 LLM 与世界模型交互而不是一次性推理来执行前瞻临床推理。The returned simulated outcomes are then incorporated into subsequent reasoning steps, allowing the Teacher LLM to refine its analysis over multiple simulation rounds before making a final decision. This data teaches the model how to perform lookahead clinical reasoning via explicit Teacher LLM–world model interaction rather than one-shot inference.

药剂处方数据Agentic Prescription Data

In this stage, the Teacher LLM receives the patient state𝒮t\mathcal{S}_{t}，来自世界模型的累积模拟反馈，以及面向决策的指令, the accumulated simulation feedback from the world model, and a decision-oriented instructionqrxq_{\text{rx}}，连同参考医师行动, together with a reference physician actionat∗a_{t}^{*}。法学硕士教师需要提出基于临床的理由并援引. The Teacher LLM is required to generate a clinically grounded rationale and invoke the处方prescription产生与参考一致的治疗动作的工具：tool to produce a treatment action consistent with the reference:

at=Teacher LLM​(𝒮t,qrx,{𝒮^t+1(i)},at∗)a_{t}=\text{Teacher LLM}(\mathcal{S}_{t},q_{\text{rx}},\{\hat{\mathcal{S}}_{t+1}^{(i)}\},a_{t}^{*})

这些数据使模型能够学习如何将基于世界模型的模拟合成为与医生实践相一致的具体治疗决策。This data enables the model to learn how to synthesize world-model-based simulations into a concrete treatment decision aligned with physician practice.

G.1.3 第三阶段Stage III训练数据Training Data

在第三阶段，我们为模型提供与第二阶段相同的患者信息，以与第二阶段完全相同的格式构建训练提示，并要求模型通过与世界模型的交互来完成训练。In the third stage, we provide the model with the same patient information as in Stage II, construct training prompts in exactly the same format as those used in Stage II, and require the model to complete training through interaction with the world model.

G.2 训练设置Training Settings

我们采用三阶段训练流程，包括两个全参数监督微调 (SFT) 阶段，后面是带有 GRPO 的代理强化学习阶段。所有阶段均在 8 个具有混合精度 bfloat16 的 H200 GPU 上进行训练。We employ a three-stage training pipeline consisting of two full-parameter supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stages followed by an agentic reinforcement learning stage with GRPO. All stages are trained on 8 H200 GPUs with mixed-precision bfloat16.

第一阶段Stage I

在第一阶段，我们使用大约 10 万个训练实例对主干模型进行全参数监督微调。该模型训练了 2 个 epoch，每设备批量大小为 4，梯度累积超过 8 个步骤，有效批量大小为 256。我们使用的学习率为In the first stage, we perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on the backbone model using approximately 100k training instances. The model is trained for 2 epochs with a per-device batch size of 4 and gradient accumulation over 8 steps, resulting in an effective batch size of 256. We use a learning rate of1×10−51\times 10^{-5}预热比率为 0.05。最大输入长度设置为 81,920 个标记，以支持长上下文临床推理。with a warmup ratio of 0.05. The maximum input length is set to 81,920 tokens to support long-context clinical reasoning.

第二阶段Stage II

第二阶段继续使用约 1k 个实例的更小、更高质量的数据集进行全参数监督微调，重点是完善决策模式。训练设置与第一阶段基本一致，只是每个设备的训练批量大小减少到 1 以适应更复杂的样本。该模型以相同的学习率训练 2 个 epoch（The second stage continues full-parameter supervised fine-tuning with a smaller, higher-quality dataset of approximately 1k instances, focusing on refining decision-making patterns. The training setup remains largely consistent with Stage I, except that the per-device training batch size is reduced to 1 to accommodate more complex samples. The model is trained for 2 epochs with the same learning rate (1×10−51\times 10^{-5}）、全局批量大小 (64)、预热比率 (0.05)、DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 2 和最大序列长度（81,920 个令牌）。), global batch size (64), warmup ratio (0.05), DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 2, and maximum sequence length (81,920 tokens).

第三阶段Stage III

In the final stage, we apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [38]using approximately 3k training trajectories.该代理与临床世界模型环境交互，并在 8 个 GPU 上进行训练。 We use a learning rate ofusing approximately 3k training trajectories. The agent interacts with a clinical world model environment and is trained on 8 GPUs. We use a learning rate of1×10−61\times 10^{-6}预热比率为 0.05。训练批量大小为 16，PPO 小批量大小为 8，每个 GPU 的微批量大小为 1。最大提示和响应长度分别设置为 8,192 和 81,920 个令牌，推出模型长度高达 102,400 个令牌，以支持长范围多轮交互。应用 KL 正则化，系数为 0.001。 We terminate the GRPO training after 300 steps.with a warmup ratio of 0.05. The training batch size is 16, with a PPO mini-batch size of 8 and a micro-batch size of 1 per GPU. The maximum prompt and response lengths are set to 8,192 and 81,920 tokens, respectively, with rollout model length up to 102,400 tokens to support long-horizon multi-turn interactions. KL regularization is applied with a coefficient of 0.001. We terminate the GRPO training after 300 steps.

G.3 奖励功能详情Reward Function Details

我们定义推出奖励是为了鼓励长期生存、短期生理稳定和符合指南的治疗。如节中所述We define the rollout reward to encourage long-term survival, short-term physiological stabilization, and guideline-consistent treatment. As described in Section4.4，总奖励为, the total reward is

R​(τ)=Rout​(sT)+∑t=0T−1r​(st,st+1)−λg​Pg​(τ).R(\tau)=R_{\mathrm{out}}(s_{T})+\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}r(s_{t},s_{t+1})-\lambda_{g}P_{g}(\tau).

遵循 DDQN 中用于脓毒症治疗的中间奖励设计Following the intermediate reward design used in DDQN for sepsis treatment[31]，逐步生理奖励定义为：, the step-wise physiological reward is defined as:

r​(st,st+1)=C0​𝕀​(st+1SOFA=stSOFA∧st+1SOFA>0)+C1​(st+1SOFA−stSOFA)+C2​tanh⁡(st+1Lactate−stLactate),\begin{split}r(s_{t},s_{t+1})&=C_{0}\mathbb{I}\left(s_{t+1}^{\mathrm{SOFA}}=s_{t}^{\mathrm{SOFA}}\land s_{t+1}^{\mathrm{SOFA}}>0\right)\\ &\quad+C_{1}\left(s_{t+1}^{\mathrm{SOFA}}-s_{t}^{\mathrm{SOFA}}\right)\\ &\quad+C_{2}\tanh\left(s_{t+1}^{\mathrm{Lactate}}-s_{t}^{\mathrm{Lactate}}\right),\end{split} (2)

哪里where𝕀​(⋅)\mathbb{I}(\cdot)是指标函数。我们设定is the indicator function. We setC0=−0.025C_{0}=-0.025, C1=−0.125C_{1}=-0.125, 和, andC2=−2C_{2}=-2。第一项惩罚非零 SOFA 状态的停滞，第二项惩罚 SOFA 恶化，第三项惩罚乳酸增加。双曲正切限制了乳酸项的大小，防止中间奖励主导最终结果。. The first term penalizes stagnation in nonzero SOFA states, the second term penalizes SOFA deterioration, and the third term penalizes lactate increase. The hyperbolic tangent caps the magnitude of the lactate term, preventing intermediate rewards from dominating terminal outcomes.

For terminal outcomes, we assign Rout=+15R_{\mathrm{out}}=+15为了生存和for survival andRout=−15R_{\mathrm{out}}=-15为了死亡率。为了阻止临床上不可信的行为，我们采用固定惩罚for mortality. To discourage clinically implausible actions, we apply a fixed penalty of−10-10for sepsis guideline violations.如果代理未能在允许的最大交互步骤内达成最终决策并重复查询世界模型，我们会施加额外的惩罚for sepsis guideline violations. If the agent fails to reach a terminal decision within the maximum allowed interaction steps and repeatedly queries the world model, we apply an additional penalty of−5-5。为了训练稳定性，总奖励按比例缩放. For training stability, the total reward is scaled by0.10.1并剪裁到and clipped to[−2,2][-2,2].

我们使用离政策评估（OPE）来评估治疗政策，因为与 ICU 患者直接在线互动是不可行的。让We evaluate treatment policies using off-policy evaluation (OPE), since direct online interaction with ICU patients is infeasible. Let𝒟={τi}i=1N\mathcal{D}=\{\tau_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N}表示根据行为政策收集的一组回顾性轨迹denote a set of retrospective trajectories collected under the behavior policyπb\pi_{b}, where each trajectory is

τi={(si,0,ai,0,ri,0),…,(si,Ti,ai,Ti,ri,Ti)}.\tau_{i}=\{(s_{i,0},a_{i,0},r_{i,0}),\ldots,(s_{i,T_{i}},a_{i,T_{i}},r_{i,T_{i}})\}.

The target policy to be evaluated is denoted by πe\pi_{e}。 We define the cumulative return of trajectory. We define the cumulative return of trajectoryii as

Gi=∑t=0Tiγt​ri,t,G_{i}=\sum_{t=0}^{T_{i}}\gamma^{t}r_{i,t},

重要性比率。Importance ratios.

对于每个轨迹，轨迹级别和每个决策重要性比率定义为For each trajectory, the trajectory-level and per-decision importance ratios are defined as

ρi=∏t=0Tiπe​(ai,t∣si,t)πb​(ai,t∣si,t),ρi,t=∏k=0tπe​(ai,k∣si,k)πb​(ai,k∣si,k).\rho_{i}=\prod_{t=0}^{T_{i}}\frac{\pi_{e}(a_{i,t}\mid s_{i,t})}{\pi_{b}(a_{i,t}\mid s_{i,t})},\qquad\rho_{i,t}=\prod_{k=0}^{t}\frac{\pi_{e}(a_{i,k}\mid s_{i,k})}{\pi_{b}(a_{i,k}\mid s_{i,k})}.

这些比率纠正了临床医生行为政策和评估政策之间的分布不匹配。These ratios correct the distribution mismatch between the clinician behavior policy and the evaluated policy.

Weighted Importance Sampling.

加权重要性采样 (WIS) 标准化轨迹级别重要性权重以减少方差Weighted Importance Sampling (WIS) normalizes trajectory-level importance weights to reduce variance[30]:

V^WIS=∑i=1Nρi​Gi∑i=1Nρi+ϵ,\hat{V}_{\mathrm{WIS}}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{N}\rho_{i}G_{i}}{\sum_{i=1}^{N}\rho_{i}+\epsilon},

哪里whereϵ\epsilon是数值稳定性的一个小常数。is a small constant for numerical stability.

Weighted Per-Decision Importance Sampling.

加权每决策重要性采样 (WPDIS) 在每个决策步骤而不是在整个轨迹级别应用归一化Weighted Per-Decision Importance Sampling (WPDIS) applies normalization at each decision step rather than at the full-trajectory level[30]:

V^WPDIS=∑t=0Tγt​∑i=1N𝕀​(t≤Ti)​ρi,t​ri,t∑i=1N𝕀​(t≤Ti)​ρi,t+ϵ.\hat{V}_{\mathrm{WPDIS}}=\sum_{t=0}^{T}\gamma^{t}\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{N}\mathbb{I}(t\leq T_{i})\rho_{i,t}r_{i,t}}{\sum_{i=1}^{N}\mathbb{I}(t\leq T_{i})\rho_{i,t}+\epsilon}.

与 WIS 相比，WPDIS 更好地解释了逐步治疗效果，并且可以减少长临床轨迹的方差。Compared with WIS, WPDIS better accounts for step-wise treatment effects and can reduce variance in long clinical trajectories.

Doubly Robust estimation.

We also report the Doubly Robust (DR) estimator [14], which combines importance weighting with an approximate value model.让, which combines importance weighting with an approximate value model. LetQ^​(s,a)\hat{Q}(s,a) be the estimated action-value function and

V^​(s)=∑a∈𝒜πe​(a∣s)​Q^​(s,a).\hat{V}(s)=\sum_{a\in\mathcal{A}}\pi_{e}(a\mid s)\hat{Q}(s,a).

每轨迹 DR 估计递归计算为The per-trajectory DR estimate is computed recursively as

V^i,tDR=V^​(si,t)+ρi,t​(ri,t+γ​V^i,t+1DR−Q^​(si,t,ai,t)),\hat{V}^{\mathrm{DR}}_{i,t}=\hat{V}(s_{i,t})+\rho_{i,t}\left(r_{i,t}+\gamma\hat{V}^{\mathrm{DR}}_{i,t+1}-\hat{Q}(s_{i,t},a_{i,t})\right),

具有终止条件with terminal conditionV^i,Ti+1DR=0\hat{V}^{\mathrm{DR}}_{i,T_{i}+1}=0。最终的 DR 估计为. The final DR estimate is

V^DR=1N​∑i=1NV^i,0DR.\hat{V}_{\mathrm{DR}}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\hat{V}^{\mathrm{DR}}_{i,0}.

DR 的准确性取决于估计值函数的质量。 WD3QNE 之前的工作指出目标不准确The accuracy of DR depends on the quality of the estimated value function. Prior work on WD3QNE notes that inaccurate targetQQ-价值估计会引入高估或低估偏差，并提出自适应加权目标-value estimation can introduce overestimation or underestimation bias, and proposes an adaptive weighted targetQQ-平衡Dueling DQN的高估倾向和D3QN的低估倾向的价值函数-value function to balance the overestimation tendency of Dueling DQN and the underestimation tendency of D3QN[48]。因此，我们按照 WD3QNE 实现来估计. Therefore, we follow the WD3QNE implementation to estimateQ^​(s,a)\hat{Q}(s,a)用于灾难恢复评估。for DR evaluation.

附录JAppendix J失效模式分析Failure Mode Analysis

本节是对本节的补充This section complements Section3.3通过分析为什么单独访问世界模型可能会失败。我们发现，具有世界模型反馈的通用法学硕士的主要失败模式是贪婪和激进的治疗策略：模型过度遵循短期模拟改进，例如立即 MAP 恢复，同时忽视长期风险，例如过度升压药或液体暴露。by analyzing why world-model access alone may fail. We find that the main failure mode of generic LLMs with world-model feedback is a greedy and aggressive treatment strategy: the model over-follows short-horizon simulated improvements, such as immediate MAP recovery, while overlooking longer-term risks such as excessive vasopressor or fluid exposure.

我们使用专家定义的不安全行为指标进一步量化这种模式。我们对 241 个事件进行了采样，并请四位人类专家手动验证已识别的失败，其中包括两名医生和两名医学硕士学位持有者，他们都来自急诊医学。在世界模型增强的法学硕士中，We further quantify this pattern using the expert-defined unsafe-action metrics. We sample 241 episodes and ask four human experts to manually validate the identified failures, including two medical doctors and two medical master’s degree holders, all from emergency medicine. Among world-model-augmented LLMs,o3+WMo3 + WM表现出服药过量失败exhibits overdosing failures in7.1%7.1\%剧集数，of episodes,Gemini-3-Flash + WM in 7.8%7.8\%, 和, andGPT-4.1-迷你+WMGPT-4.1-mini + WM in 10.3%10.3\%。相比之下，. In contrast,败血症代理SepsisAgent仅显示shows only0.8%0.8\%服药过量失败，相当于241次发作中的2例。这些结果支持了这样的观点：仅靠世界模式的获取是不够的；代理必须学会在长期临床风险的背景下解释模拟的患者反应。overdosing failures, corresponding to 2 cases among 241 episodes. These results support the observation that world-model access alone is insufficient; the agent must learn to interpret simulated patient responses in the context of long-term clinical risk.
